replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body: wow you already pushed to app store, what did you use to build & what was the cost to store?

replies.author: MastermindGames_io
replies.body: This took about a year. Its my very first game - i have no experience in unity but a passion for creating. I used claude and unity. Total cost was about 3k. Most of those costs are getting the custom assets (I wish I had meshy.ai back in the early stages)
